Worlds 2027 Swiss Stage Goes to Nagoya, With Knockouts in South Korea Sergey Demidov Head of News Department Fact checked by: Sol Fayerman-Hansen Updated: Nov 15, 2026, 6:04 PM Published: Nov 15, 2026, 6:04 PM 5 min read Editorial Standards Why Trust Us? Riot Games will take the League of Legends Worlds 2027 Swiss stage to Nagoya, the tournament's first stop in Japan, then move the knockouts to South Korea, culminating in the final at the new Seoul Arena. (Riot Games) Riot Games will take the League of Legends Worlds 2027 Swiss stage to Nagoya, the tournament's first stop in Japan, then move the knockouts to South Korea, culminating in the final at the new Seoul Arena. LoL Esports announced the 2027 international calendar on Nov. 13, a day before Bilibili Gaming beat Gen.G to win Worlds 2026 in Brooklyn . Dates have not been announced. Riot said more details will come in January. Knockouts Head to Suwon and a New Seoul Arena The official announcement lists the quarterfinals and semifinals at the Suwon Convention Center and the final at Seoul Arena. Esports.net, citing Financial News, said the arena is still under construction, with completion due in May 2027 and an opening in June. Riot is also evaluating whether the Demacia Cup could replace the traditional Worlds play-in in 2027, but said no decision has been finalized. MSI Goes to Valencia MSI 2027 will be held at the Feria de Valencia in Valencia, Spain, the first time the event has gone to Spain, LoL Esports said. Exact dates and ticket information have not been released. This website uses cookies to ensure you get the best experience on our website. Read our Privacy Policy . Okay First Stand: All In Moves to China The 2027 First Stand will be a one-off expansion branded First Stand: All In, moved to China from a previously announced Southeast Asia location. Riot described it as the largest tournament it has produced and said the format and qualification process will be detailed in January. First Stand is scheduled to go to Southeast Asia in 2028. Fans in states with legal sports betting, such as New York and New Jersey , can find more coverage on RG.org's esports news hub . LoL Esports' 2027 Calendar By The Numbers 1st Worlds Stop In Japan Nagoya will host the Worlds 2027 Swiss stage before the event moves to South Korea. Statistics 2 Korean Venues For The Knockouts Suwon Convention Center hosts the quarterfinals and semifinals, and the new Seoul Arena hosts the final. Statistics May 2027 Completion For Seoul Arena The arena is still under construction, with an opening due in June, Esports.net reported. Statistics 1st MSI In Spain MSI 2027 heads to the Feria de Valencia, with dates and tickets still to come. Sergey Demidov is a veteran sports journalist with over 18 years of experience covering international sports. Since beginning his career in 2007, he has reported on the Olympic Games (Sochi 2014), FIFA World Cup (2014), UEFA Euro (2012), World Cup of Hockey (2016), and Stanley Cup Finals (since 2017).

Before joining RG, Sergey was an independent senior editor at NHL.com/ru (2016–present) and contributed to Gazeta.ru and TASS News Agency. Currently, he leads RG’s global news desk, overseeing correspondents across North America, Europe, Africa, Asia, and South America.

He has conducted one-on-one interviews with elite athletes, including Jaromir Jagr and Alex Ovechkin, former WADA and FIFA presidents Craig Reedie and Sepp Blatter, and soccer coaches like Fabio Capello.

Sergey’s editorial work emphasizes accuracy, sourcing transparency, and a neutral voice, aligned with the Trust Project and Google Publisher Center principles.

He is bilingual in English and Russian, specializing in NHL hockey.
